actions.label: Renewal price for plans renewing in weeks 9 and 10
40 extra year-end support staff for 6 weeks

decisions.message: Year-end is coming and we want you to be ready. If your annual plan renews in late December or early January, the increase is 10%, not the 20% we planned. We have added 40 support specialists through mid-January and an outside team is testing our January 1 update for the new IRS 1099 system, state minimum wages and tax tables. Exporting your data stays free, always.
why: A third of annual plans renew in January; a 20% rise at the riskiest moment invites churn.
Year-end support answers in 8 hours; the board wants 4.
Testing is only 80% done; an outside team lowers the chance of payroll failures on Jan 1.

actions.label: Dedicated accountant phone line for 6 weeks
Public status page, incident reports and accountant text alerts

decisions.message: With IRS phone lines closed during the federal shutdown and the January 1 changes here, you need answers from us fast. From today partner accountants have a dedicated Quillbook phone line through early February, and for the next six months your commission on renewing and new clients doubles from 10% to 20%. Our public status page reports any Quillbook incident with text alerts to you. We are also sorry for the late deposits in November.
why: IRS phone lines are closed, so accountants lose a source of answers during the January 1 switch.
Accountants decide for 60% of customers; a direct line, honest incident reports and a higher commission keep them with us.
The commission rewards keeping clients through the 1099 deadline and February, when the CEO fears they move.
